shinigami_captive_talk:
SHINIGAMI: Nero bound my dead into
his army. I said no. Chained.

SHINIGAMI: Three apprentices died.
Beat the Captain. Open this door.
captain_defeat_intro:
CAPTAIN: Halt! This is a JRA base.
Nobody opens that cell. Turn back.

LEAF: That cell holds Shinigami.
I need him. Move, or fight.
captain_defeat_win:
CAPTAIN: I was told to hold him.
Take the key. The JRA will hear.
free_shinigami:
Leaf unlocks the cell door.
Shinigami steps into the light.

Shinigami hands Leaf a scroll.
The Scroll of Resurrection.

SHINIGAMI: It wakes the dead.
Human or POKéMON. Use it well.
shinigami_leaves:
Shinigami walks out of the base
past the fallen Captain.

SHINIGAMI: Team Rocket killed my
Pikachu. I hunt their grunts now.

Shinigami is gone. A black feather
falls where he stood.
anne_news:
Anne is waiting outside the base.
Her face is grey.

ANNE: Leaf. I'm so sorry.
Your father died. Just now.

LEAF: No. He was only sleeping.
He was fine when I left him.

ANNE: His breath just stopped.
I wanted you to hear it from me.

LEAF: Shinigami raises the dead.
I have the scroll. I can fix this.
choice_prompt:
Use the scroll on Father,
or speak YVELTAL's name?
choice_father:
Leaf unrolls the scroll on Father.
His eyes open. He is breathing.

The scroll burns to ash. The old
man sits up, shaking.
father_revived_talk:
FATHER: Leaf? I was already gone.
You pulled me back anyway.

LEAF: I still need you.
Whatever comes, we face it.

FATHER: Then you have me. Thanks.
I'm with you to the end.

Father joins your party.
He carries six more POKéMON.
choice_yveltal:
Leaf speaks YVELTAL's name instead.
The scroll points toward Lavender.

LEAF: Wake, YVELTAL. Be mine.
Your grave: the POKéMON Tower.
yveltal_grave_need_scroll:
A cold grave in the POKéMON Tower.
No scroll. The runes stay dark.
yveltal_rise:
The earth splits. YVELTAL rises.
Its wings blot out the sky.

YVELTAL: Who dares wake me?
A child? Then this will be quick.
It attacks. No time to rest.
yveltal_tamed:
YVELTAL folds its black wings.
It bows its head to Leaf.

YVELTAL: You called me.
I will stay with you.
yveltal_defeated:
YVELTAL falls and does not rise.
The sky closes over the tower.

LEAF: The price of power is paid.
Now no one stands against me.
yveltal_max_dies:
YVELTAL's last strike lands.
Leaf falls, and does not get up.

They bury her outside Pallet Town,
under a plain stone.
nero_spot:
NERO: So. The girl from Pallet.
I held my queen as she died.

NERO: Twelve years ago, I swore
no one would ever leave me again.

NERO: Every soul stays with me.
Even the dead. Especially them.

LEAF: You call that keeping them?
I call it refusing to let go.

NERO: You came for a dead father.
Don't pretend you're different.
nero_defeated:
Nero's last POKéMON falls.
Outside, the wailing goes quiet.

A woman in a pale gown stands
behind the throne. The queen.

She rests a hand on his shoulder.
Then she is gone, like the rest.

NERO: She's gone. Well? Finish it.
Or chain me. I will not beg.
nero_choice_prompt:
Nero kneels, beaten and silent.
What becomes of him?
nero_arrest:
Leaf locks the Golden Shackles on
Nero's wrists.

LEAF: You stand trial. Every town
you burned gets to watch.

Weeks later, the square fills.
Nero stands before the people.

Witness after witness speaks.
The judge reads every charge.

Guilty on every count.
Nero goes to prison for life.

He does not look at Leaf
as they take him away.
nero_execute:
LEAF: No trial. No prison.
Just this.

The throne room erupts in screams.
Then it stops.

A ring rolls across the floor.
It stops at Leaf's feet.
nero_crowned:
The JRA has no king. It needs one.
It fears only one person.

They crown Leaf with Nero's crown.
Nobody cheers.

Leaf, the Kingslayer, is crowned
the new Queen.
father_end_proud:
Leaf walks home to Pallet Town.
Father is waiting on the step.

FATHER: You put him on trial.
Less blood. I'm proud of you.
FATHER: I have never been prouder.
father_end_sacrifice:
Leaf walks home to Pallet Town.
Father is waiting on the step.

FATHER: I heard what you did.
I know the fighter you became.

FATHER: Still, you gave him trial.
Maybe the rest was a sacrifice.
father_end_monster:
Leaf walks home to Pallet Town.
Father is waiting on the step.

FATHER: You killed a beaten man.
Then you took his crown.

FATHER: I raised you better.
You are a monster.

Father walks out of Pallet Town
and does not look back.
epi_war:
The JRA is finished.
The towns of Johto are free.
epi_trial:
Nero lives out his days in a
prison cell, far from the throne.
epi_crowned:
Queen Leaf, the Kingslayer, rules
from the throne.
epi_father_stays:
Father comes home to Pallet Town
with her.
epi_father_gone: Father never speaks to her again.
epi_none:
Leaf has no god at her side.
She never needed one.
epi_tamed:
YVELTAL stays at her side for the
rest of her days.
epi_godslayer:
They call her Godslayer now.
Nobody says it to her face.
epi_bloody:
Leaf The Bloody is dead.
The songs about her are not kind.
rep_refuse:
SHOPKEEPER: No. Not for you.
Not after what you have done.
rep_expensive:
SHOPKEEPER: Prices are up for you.
Word travels. Pay the full price.
rep_discount:
SHOPKEEPER: The people like you.
A small discount, just for you.
rep_free:
SHOPKEEPER: Take it. It's free.
The town owes you, Leaf.
max_fights_bare_2: No POKéMON. Leaf fights as herself.
max_fights_bare_3: Fists up. She is not afraid.
